description: Create a pair of Airflow 2.4+ DAGs for ecom_market using data-aware scheduling. Producer DAGs 'orders_ingest' and 'inventory_ingest' each end with a task that declares outlets=[Dataset(...)] for their output tables. The consumer DAG 'stock_availability' must be scheduled on both datasets and run only after both have been updated since its last run. The consumer should: (1) read the triggering dataset events to determine the min and max source data intervals, (2) recompute availability for that range, (3) publish its own Dataset for downstream consumers.

expected_behavior.trigger_semantics: AND - runs once both datasets have at least one new event

edge_cases: A dataset-triggered run has no meaningful data interval; the date range must come from triggering_dataset_events, not from ds
If orders_ingest runs three times before inventory_ingest runs once, the consumer runs once and must process all three orders updates
Outlet must be attached to the final publishing task; attaching it to an early task emits the event before data is ready
Dataset events are emitted only on task success; a producer that skips its final task does not trigger the consumer
Dataset URIs must match exactly between producer and consumer (case and trailing slash)
common_failure_modes: FM6: Consumer uses {{ ds }} for filtering and processes only the trigger day, missing accumulated upstream updates
FM6: Outlet declared on the extract task, so the consumer starts before the producer's load finishes
FM2: Using only the latest dataset event's interval drops earlier queued intervals
